{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cularin New Comer Center''' was a building that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The center provided support to individuals who had recently arrived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], providing information on how to navigate around the [[Star system/Legends|system]], where to find local services, and help on gaining employment. The [[Metatheran Cartel]] made a number of donations to the center's program.
